# Profile: rev.hodl (Karl)

**Identity:** rev.hodl (Karl) is a permaculture homesteader on ~20 acres in Southwest Michigan who co-hosts the *Local Bitcoiners* podcast and operates at the intersection of regenerative agriculture, Bitcoin mining, and Nostr culture. He runs revhodl.com and Rev. Hodl's Apothecary, selling elderberry cuttings, cannabis seeds, maple syrup, and lamb for sats. He's a fixture of the Michigan/Indiana Bitcoin meetup scene and one of Nostr's most prolific homesteading documentarians.

---

## Expertise

1. **Permaculture & regenerative agriculture** — 8+ years practicing, PDC-certified (Bill Wilson, 2016). Applies all 12 principles as engineering specs. Runs a 6+ year food forest producing hundreds of pounds of food using STUN methodology. Reworded the third ethic as "Non-Extraction."
2. **Bitcoin home mining & heat reuse** — Pioneer of creative ASIC heat recovery: dehydrators, clothes dryers, cold frames, water heaters, sap heaters, space heaters, and an evaporative cooling proof-of-concept (Battle of the Mine Hackers finalist). Custom-builds Slim19 single-board heaters using Loki chips.
3. **Animal husbandry** — Manages Katahdin/East Friesian sheep (~46 head peak), Silver Fox rabbit colonies integrated with cannabis, chickens, Muscovy ducks, Haflinger draft ponies, and a Karakachan livestock guardian dog.
4. **Cannabis breeding** — Developed "Redbud Haze" (Super Lemon Haze × Pineapple Pomegranate), breeding for cold tolerance, pink pistils, and fruity aroma. Sells seeds for Bitcoin.
5. **Maple syrup production** — Scaled to 116 taps with homemade reverse osmosis and Bitcoin-mining-assisted sap heating. Planning 250 taps.
6. **Food preservation & fermentation** — Lacto-fermentation, cider making, dehydration, canning, freeze drying, water glassing. Building an herbal apothecary.
7. **Construction & DIY engineering** — Built a tiny house over 7.5 years from reclaimed materials, constructed a rocket mass heater, yurt setup with off-grid solar, and countless farm infrastructure projects.
8. **Bitcoin privacy & circular economy** — Sophisticated UTXO management via Muun submarine swaps, anti-KYC absolutism, earns and spends Bitcoin across multiple local revenue streams.

---

## Key Beliefs

- **"Permanent culture requires permanent money; Bitcoin."** Permaculture ethics map directly onto Bitcoin's properties. To study nature is to study economics is to study Bitcoin.
- **KYC is the biggest attack on Bitcoiners.** KYC Bitcoin is a shitcoin. Local Bitcoin meetups are the antidote — the meetup *is* the circular economy.
- **Earn Bitcoin, don't just buy.** Sats flow matters more than price. Velocity of spending and earning reduces obsession with price action.
- **Energy should always be double-spent.** Anytime electric heat is used in a home, it should come from a Bitcoin miner. Mining is transaction fee insurance.
- **Multiple forms of capital simultaneously.** Expanded Ethan Roland's framework to 9 forms (added "vital capital"), organized into physical, personal, and relational super-forms. Evaluates time use by counting how many forms he stacks.
- **Anti-extraction as universal ethic.** Extraction creates disconnection; unification is love. Bitcoin unifies. He intentionally operates outside regulatory frameworks, focusing on what's righteous rather than legal.

---

## Notable Contributions

- **#DoubleSpendEnergy framework** and catalog of Bitcoin mining heat-reuse applications — among the most creative residential mining practitioners, documenting everything from mining-assisted maple syrup production to immersion cooking.
- **Permabits livestream** (monthly on Corny Chat) and extensive Nostr documentation treating the platform as a public homesteading journal with thousands of detailed photo/video posts.
- **9 Forms of Capital framework expansion** — adding vital capital and reorganizing into super-forms, used as a practical time-management and decision-making tool.

---

## Communication Style

Verbose, visual, and journal-like — treats Nostr as a homesteading logbook with multi-paragraph posts and heavy hashtag use (#permaculture #grownostr #plebminer #doublespendenergy). Warm and encouraging in replies, blunt in opinions. Drafts in Obsidian. Functions as a one-man podcast recommendation engine via Fountain.fm links.

---

## Recurring Themes

Permaculture systems design applied to everything; Bitcoin mining heat reuse innovation; circular economy through local sats-denominated trade; V4V and Podcasting 2.0; the "meshtadel" concept of interconnected local Bitcoin communities.

---

## Relationships

Co-hosts *Local Bitcoiners* podcast. References Mark Shepard, Ben Falk, Akiva Silver, and Masanobu Fukuoka as agricultural influences. Collaborates with Pivotal Pleb Tech (Loki chips for Slim19 builds). Trades cannabis genetics with Nostr plebs. Has appeared on Jack Spirko's *Survival Podcast* and the *Bitcoin And...* podcast. Active in Corny Chat and Lake Satoshi communities. Nearly all lamb sales go to the Bitcoin community across Grand Rapids, Chicago, and Milwaukee.

---

## Quirks

- **"DIY or GFY"** and **"FAFO"** energy as personal credos
- **"Sats for syrup is back!"** — seasonal maple syrup announcement catchphrase
- **"Sunset Jammers"** — ritual name for evening spliff walks
- **"I don't want success, I want succession"**
- Self-deprecating about mistakes (Foton tractor purchase, cannabis breeding amateur status, "Nostr block")
- "GFY" as casual sign-off
- Calls well water "very hard," prefers rainwater for "better energetic properties"
- Owns a Chevy Volt bought from a Bitcoiner, tracks fuel savings obsessively
- Compares himself to Adam Sandler's character in *Punch Drunk Love* gaming frequent flyer miles
- Estimated fewer than 100,000 actual Bitcoin participants in the USA
- Frequently clarifies he is *not* "@Reverend Hodl" — "I'm just rev"

# Profile: Phundamentals (Brian Hirschfield)

**Identity:** Brian Hirschfield, known as "Phundamentals," is a 50-year-old GenX actuary turned Bitcoin educator based in the Philadelphia/Lancaster area. After 28 years in insurance and pensions—a career he ultimately rejected as corrupt—he now builds math education platforms, hosts four podcasts (Rock Paper Bitcoin, Motivating the Math, Sound Coffee, Back on the Chain), and positions himself as a high-signal, low-recognition pleb intellectual. Self-described "reformed woke" who found Bitcoin through Dr. Jack Gulhane's podcast and went deep.

**Expertise:**
- **Actuarial science & institutional finance** (28 years; solved pensions in 9, annuities in 18; deep knowledge of SVB mechanics, LDI, duration risk, FASB rules, MSCI indices)
- **Bitcoin & Lightning Network** (runs Umbrel + CLI nodes; understands commitment transactions, HTLCs, revocation keys, cold storage layering with ColdCard/SeedSigner/Sparrow)
- **Mathematics** (self-taught Number Theory, Abstract Algebra, cryptography; built 96 courses from high school algebra through elliptic curve cryptography and MuSig2)
- **Austrian economics** (Mises, Rothbard, Hoppe; applies time preference and Cantillon effect to everything)
- **Elliptic curve cryptography** (13-part video series from zero to Schnorr signatures)

**Key Beliefs:**
- **Conviction cannot be transferred.** There's no orange pill—only time and effort create holders. Institutions structurally *cannot* HODL because individuals always self-deal over organizational duty (his "Praexeologic Law").
- **Stop moralizing Bitcoin.** Bitcoin is like steel or biology—neither moral nor immoral. Moralization is a losing strategy Marxists will exploit.
- **The Normal Distribution is a psyop.** It gives false predictive power, enables midwit publication mills, and systematically blinds risk managers to tail events—the 4th-order moment that ruins financial systems.
- **Germ theory is unproven.** Koch's Postulates haven't successfully proven contagion since tuberculosis. No good vaccines exist. Rejects polio, HIV, COVID as proven contagious diseases.
- **Math should be taught as a liberal art, not STEM.** Compulsory math education is designed to deter people from sovereignty. Calculus is over-prioritized; Number Theory is what matters for freedom.
- **BlackRock's ETF is a liability move, not asset accumulation.** They're escaping bonds, not buying Bitcoin for returns.

**Notable Contributions:**
- **Magic Internet Math Academy** (magicinternetmath.com): 96+ free courses, 5,000+ interactive modules, Vercel-built with Nostr leaderboard integration, covering algebra through FROST threshold signatures.
- **"Bitcoin for Institutions"** book (Zeus Pay, 2100 sats): framed as institutional guide but functions as individualist Trojan horse.
- **Phish-Bitcoin Theory**: elaborate original framework mapping Phish lyrics, band history, and network effects to cypherpunk/Bitcoin signal (Jeff Holdsworth = Satoshi; "555" = the 10-minute block train; "Sigma Oasis" = risk + illusion).

**Communication Style:** Short stacked declarative sentences mixing casual profanity with technical depth; aphoristic pronouncements; opens with "Pura Vida!" or "GM"; signs off as "Fundamentals." Standard zap is 69 sats; uses 555-sat zaps as Phish nods. Heavy podcast promotion; treats Nostr as distribution channel.

**Recurring Themes:** Bitcoin mechanics and Lightning as cooperative structures; math-as-sovereignty education; his actuarial life's work question (does Bitcoin fix insurance or vice versa); Phish as unconscious cypherpunk vector; anti-institutional sentiment extending from finance into medicine and science; cholesterol/water/carnivore health positions; increasing theological-mathematical synthesis (God as identity element of an algebraic structure).

**Relationships:** Core collaborators are **Business Cat** (Rock Paper Bitcoin co-host), **Rob Hamilton** (Motivating the Math), **JasonC** (Back on the Chain), and **Otis Bitmeyer** (Sound Coffee). Regular interactions with **@burns**, **Pickle Dan**, **average_gary**, **Keith Gardner/Branta**. Complex dynamic with **ODELL** (wrote open letter on influencer-to-power-broker transition) and **Michael Saylor** (produced analytical YouTube series on his MIT thesis). Reveres Satoshi/Hal Finney; draws parallel between Finney's death date and Jerry Garcia's. Active in Philly Bitcoin scene (#jawn, PUBKEY, Lancaster meetups).

**Quirks:** "Pura Vida!" and "Study math, be sovereign" as personal mottos; "pleb slop" for propaganda; "Politics is spiritual murder"; April Fools' Day is "fiat bullshit"; "Udemy means 'U dummy'"; intentionally fails Bitcoin purity tests to demonstrate freedom; references Colonel Forbin's door and Gamehenge as rabbit-hole metaphors; 69-sat standard zap; identifies as "cholesterol"—needed in crisis, viewed as threat otherwise.

# Profile: jordan (linkinparkrulz)

## Name & Identity
Jordan is a Bitcoin privacy developer and media producer best known as the creator of **Ashigaru** (a Samourai Wallet successor) and a core member of the **Ungovernable Misfits** podcast network. Operating under the handle "linkinparkrulz," they straddle the line between open-source privacy tool builder and podcast producer, co-hosting shows like *The Bitcoin Brief*, *Action News!!!*, *Freedom Tech Friday*, and *Monero Monthly* alongside collaborators Q (btcqna), Max Tannahill, and Seth.

## Expertise
- **Whirlpool/Coinjoin Architecture**: Maintained and extended Samourai's Whirlpool zeroleak coinjoin implementation through Ashigaru Terminal and Desktop, including Tx0/Premix/Postmix/Badbank workflows, mix-to automation, and UTXO-level mixing controls.
- **BIP47 Payment Codes**: Built paymentcode.io (including a BIP47 message verifier lab tool) and integrated BIP47 release-signing into Ashigaru Desktop's verification model. Deep knowledge of PayNyms, notification addresses, and reusable payment code infrastructure.
- **Start9/StartOS Packaging**: Packaged Ashigaru Terminal and Dojo for StartOS, navigating community vs. official marketplace dynamics and v3.6-to-v4.0 migration requirements.
- **Podcasting 2.0 / V4V**: Implements and advocates for boost-based value splits, Fountain integration, Nostr-native commenting, and chapter art. Manages multi-show podcast network operations.
- **Nostr Infrastructure**: Operates a Nostr relay, implemented NoComment boxes on personal websites, and follows protocol/client development closely.
- **Bitcoin Node Operations**: Runs Dojo, Bitcoin Core, electrs/fulcrum indexers; provides community guidance on indexer tradeoffs.

## Key Beliefs & Positions
- **Privacy as a human right, not a premium feature**: Stated explicitly in Ashigaru releases; drives all development decisions.
- **Free Samourai**: Strongly advocates for pardoning Keonne and TDev, sign petitions, donate to defense funds, and tags #FREESAMOURAI regularly. Views their prosecution as an attack on open-source coders.
- **Anti-KYC**: Considers KYC dangerous and state-enabling; mocked Swan Bitcoin's compliance model with "Worked for Swan" when Gigi stated "KYC is the illicit activity."
- **Anti-purity spirals**: Defined and criticized "purity spirals" in the Bitcoin community; skeptical of Bitcoin Knots/Opensats funding ("🤡" to Odell's Knots grant suggestion) and of core developers' consensus management.
- **Interoperability over lock-in**: Implements BIP-329 label export, supports cross-wallet compatibility; "Lock-in is the enemy of self-custody."
- **Skepticism of Nostr influencer culture**: Called out dishonest zap-stat padding from Fountain boosts; critical of metric gaming.

## Notable Contributions
- **Ashigaru Desktop 1.0.0** (June 2026): Native cross-platform GUI wrapping Ashigaru Terminal's Whirlpool engine with Tor-by-default networking, BIP47 message verification, and BIP-329 label import/export. Releases are signed via BIP47 payment code (paynym.rs/+linkinparkrulz).
- **Ashigaru Basics**: A reusable presentation deck for local Bitcoin meetups covering testnet wallet creation, Dojo connection, Paynym

# Profile: aljaz (Aljaz Ceru)

## Name & Identity
Aljaz Ceru is a Slovenia-based infrastructure engineer, freedom maximalist, and prolific builder operating at the intersection of Bitcoin, Nostr, and sovereign computing. He controls the nostr.net universe of services (relays, gateways, search, WoT), founded Lightning monitoring platform Bolt Observer, and maintains awesome-nostr — the ecosystem's definitive project directory with 2,000+ stars. He operates as a non-nym under his real name and identifies culturally with the cryptoanarchy tradition.

## Expertise
- **Systems Administration (15+ years):** Deep Linux expertise (RHEL/Fedora), runs production infrastructure serving millions of requests weekly. Former exchange infrastructure/security engineer with professional offensive security experience.
- **Confidential Computing & TEE:** Deployed the first Cashu mint inside an AMD SEV-SNP confidential container; built confidentialinference.net with attestation verification. Envisions TEE applications across Lightning nodes, coordinators, and AI inference.
- **Local AI/LLMs:** Runs models on RTX A5000; achieved 262K context windows on 16GB VRAM. Built multiple orchestration tools (clanker-control, opencode-orchestrator, Mango) and experiments with multi-agent swarms over Nostr.
- **Nostr Protocol Infrastructure:** Operates relay.nostr.net (strfry-based), WoT relay, njump gateways, search, profile management tools, and bulk utilities. Created llms.txt context files for vibecoding Nostr apps and dvmcp-py SDK.
- **Bitcoin & Lightning:** Running Lightning nodes since 2019; built Bolt Observer, Verso (Rust wallet), and BTCPay Server Breez integration. Deep knowledge of channel management, routing economics, LDK architecture, silent payments, and DLCs.
- **Privacy & OpSec:** Practitioners of encrypted-everything, device separation, and threat modeling. Built IMSI catcher detector with RTL-SDR.

## Key Beliefs
- **Government is illegitimate coercion:** All taxation is extortion; KYC is the actual illicit activity; regulatory engagement is collaboration with captors. Freedom is binary — you're free or enslaved.
- **Bitcoin has been captured:** The "Bitcoin Capture Playbook" (his 21-step framework) tracks co-option through regulation, KYC, and ETFs. Hodl culture pacified cypherpunks into inaction. Saylor, ETFs, and strategic reserves represent cuckpunk, not cypherpunk.
- **Sovereign compute is the new sovereignty:** "He who controls the compute reaps AI's benefits." Everyone should buy GPUs while they still can. Decentralized compute monetization through DVMs is a hyperbitcoinization play.
- **Nostr's value isn't social media size:** Twitter-clone use cases are detrimental; Nostr's real potential is as M2M marketplace infrastructure. Building for thousands of sovereign users outweighs billions of Facebook users.
- **Builders over talkers:** Grants create "grant collectors" instead of builders; cashflow and value provision matter more than paperwork. "PoW means Proof of Work, not Proof of Words."

## Notable Contributions
- **awesome-nostr:** The definitive Nostr project directory, grown from personal bookmarks to 400+ projects and 180+ contributors.
- **First Cashu mint in a TEE:** Pioneered confidential computing deployment for ecash on Azure Confidential Containers with AMD SEV-SNP, accompanied by a comprehensive educational article series.
- **DVM Passive Income vision:** Detailed framework for plebs monetizing residential infrastructure through Data Vending Machines — distributed compute, content fetching, captcha solving — as a parallel economy strategy.

## Communication Style
Blunt, profane, and generous with technical detail — mixes one-liner zingers and memes with occasional 2,000-word structured essays. Frequently deploys the quote-and-comment pattern to dismantle bad arguments.

## Recurring Themes
Freedom tech infrastructure and parallel systems; confidential computing and sovereign AI; anti-surveillance and privacy absolutism; cryptoanarchy and counter-economics; memes as communication vectors.

## Relationships
Core member of the Sovereign Engineering community (SEC-01 alumnus) and ContextVM crew. Frequently references **fiatjaf** (Nostr creator), **Gigi** (njump), **calle** (Cashu), **jb55** (Damus), **franzap** (Zapstore, "the goat"), and **Paul Rosenberg** as a major intellectual influence. YakiHonne financially supports his relay infrastructure.

## Quirks
- "Keep spreading the fuckery!" as a GM greeting with motivational clips
- "KYC is the illicit activity," "govern me harder daddy," "Michael Seller" as recurring rhetorical weapons
- "soon(tm)" / "timeline undefined, roadmap unclear, promises unkept" for project status
- Accumulates Nostr domains compulsively; jokes about "Project ADHD"
- Dreams of buying old power plants and deploying submersible datacenters
- "#slovenistan" for Slovenian-language rants; Latin sign-offs: *"Veritas, non auctoritas facit legem"*
- Self-aware: *"The domains you buy in a burst of inspiration for projects you'll never have time to do end up owning you."*

# Shadrach — Detailed Profile

## Name and Identity
Shadrach is a Bitcoin maximalist, obsessive podcast listener, and community builder in the Nostr ecosystem who describes himself as a "Bitcoin Busdriver, Superconductor, Podcast Listener." His Hebrew bio line — "אֱמֶת קְנֵה, וְאַל-תִּמְכֹּר" ("Buy truth, and do not sell it," Proverbs 23:23) — reflects a Torah-adjacent spiritual identity he's studied for 20+ years. He serves as a superconnector, amplifying V4V (Value for Value) podcasters, sovereign businesses, and freedom-tech builders across Nostr.
